description: This file appears to be a C source file implementing functions related to emitting diffs (generating delta reports), including formatting and contextual information, as part of the LibXDiff library. It defines internal static functions for diff record processing, hunks extraction, and diff emission, and includes key functions like 'xdl_emit_diff' for outputting diffs with context and function name annotations.

methods.name: long get_func_line(xdfenv_t * xe,xdemitconf_t const * xecfg,struct func_line * func_line,long start,long limit)

methods.name: int is_empty_rec(xdfile_t * xdf,long ri)
